about: Platinum Road enrichment for the official GTA VI trophy list in trophies.json: which trophies are hidden on the console, what kind of trophy each one is, the single missable trophy and why it can be lost, and the trophies whose methods no source has confirmed yet. Researched and cross-checked against the published list; the five unconfirmed entries say so instead of inventing steps.

28.missableReason: One of the meditation spots is tied to a Chapter 1 invitation at Jason's house and becomes permanently unavailable once Chapter 1 ends. Meditate at that spot before finishing Chapter 1; the remaining spots can be done at any time.

44.methodNote: Method unconfirmed in every source checked. The trophy's own description is the only reliable pointer: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Treat any more specific steps circulating online as unverified.

45.methodNote: Method unconfirmed in every source checked. The trophy's own description is the only reliable pointer: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom. Which showroom, vehicle, or story moment triggers it is not yet verified.

49.methodNote: Method unconfirmed in every source checked. The trophy's own description ('Second time's the charm') only implies succeeding at something on a second attempt; what exactly must be retried is not yet verified.

50.methodNote: Method unconfirmed in every source checked. The trophy's own description only implies witnessing something strange; where or what that event is has not been verified, so no location is given here.
